description: Fetch one person who bought without a company, by contact id: health, lifetimeValue (completed-order revenue plus won deals without an order), purchases, repeat, firstPurchaseAt, lastPurchaseAt and contact details. Read-only; a contact who never bought without a company is not found. Use list_people_customers or search_contacts first when you only know the name, email or phone; use get_customer for a company.

contactId.description: The contact/customer id returned by list_people_customers.
